// diagnostic

E0434

`{written}` repeats what {declarer} declares; a call is written plain.

What

`{written}` repeats what {declarer} declares; a call is written plain.

Why

A signature says what a function does to each input (`c: &Counter` edits it, `c: &&Counter` takes it), so the call reads `bump(score)`. A mark stays only on a write window bound to a name, a match that writes into its subject, and `task &&name`.

Fix

{repair}; `jet fix` applies this fix.
